title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30383: add purchase line transfer event
summary: An IsHandled integration event is published in the purchase availability transfer logic, allowing extensions to handle additional purchase document types like Blanket Orders without encountering unsupported source errors.
key_points: New IsHandled event added to TransferPurchaseLine before the unsupported-source error
Enables extensions to populate inventory page data for custom purchase document types
Preserves existing standard behavior for supported document types
Subscribers can now handle Blanket Orders and other custom purchase document types
quote: publishes an IsHandled event immediately before that error so subscribers can populate Inventory Page Data for custom document types
